ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
Tolstoy's opening Russian instruction, complete French letter, both page markers, the editors' four-part Russian rendering/publication note, and all four Markdown footnotes are represented.

The French is translated directly. débauché dans cette vie du monde is rendered let myself go in this life of society, preserving self-reproach without intensifying it into a sexual sense unsupported here.

The bare numeral 3 after fer[s]ait is preserved as source evidence. The official volume confirms it as a printed marker, while the audited Markdown does not retain its corresponding original-language note definition; this is documented under SOURCE_SUSPECTED rather than guessed.
подводы is carts in context; 200 r. argent is 200 silver rubles.
